title: Moreish Puff Sherbet Apple Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: This mouth-watering blend from Moreish Puff combines the juicy, tropical freshness of Mango with the crisp sweetness of Apple and a delightful tickle on the exhale from fizzy sherbet. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
